requirements.requirement: The system must render a malpractice section within the provider scorecard when malpractice data is present in the UI schema.
The system must display a visual status indicator icon corresponding to malpractice status values (clean, flagged, unknown).
The system must display neutral label text for malpractice status that does not include prohibited terms such as fraud or misconduct.
The system must render the state medical board link when a valid state_board_url is provided.
The system must ensure the state medical board link is passed through the MessageBubble.tsx markdown rendering pipeline before display.
The system must validate that the state_board_url uses an allowed protocol (https) before rendering it as a clickable link.
The system must display the malpractice score contribution value as provided by the UI schema.
The system must render the malpractice section in a consistent layout within the provider scorecard component.
The system must not render the state board link as clickable if the URL fails validation.
The system must display a fallback text indicating unavailable link when state_board_url is null or missing.
The system must render the malpractice section even when status is unknown, using the unknown indicator and neutral text.
The system must safely escape or sanitize any dynamic text or URL content before rendering to prevent injection via the markdown pipeline.
The system must not break or crash the scorecard UI if malpractice data fields are partially missing.
The system must ensure the malpractice section is visually distinguishable from other measures within the scorecard.
